title: JACM – Just another Create Modpack
description: Build factories and energy farms with simple technology.
body:
# JACM – Just Another Create Modpack

*Build bigger. Build smarter. Build something worth exploring.*

**JACM** is a carefully curated Create-focused modpack that goes beyond the usual suspects.
Alongside the most well-known Create modules, you'll find a selection of lesser-known mods
that slot in seamlessly — unlocking factory designs, contraptions, and automation setups
you simply can't achieve with a standard Create install.

On top of that, custom content added via **KubeJS** introduces brand-new items exclusive to
JACM, giving you fresh mechanics and new reasons to venture out and explore.

---

## What to Expect

- **Factory Building** — Design and construct machines using Cogwheels, Shafts, and a wide
  array of Create components. The expanded mod list gives you more options than ever for
  creative, efficient builds.
- **Resource Automation** — Put your engineering skills to work and automate resource
  gathering. The bigger your factory, the more you can produce.
- **Airship Travel** — Take to the skies and explore the world from above aboard fully
  functional airships.
- **Technological Surprises** — Expect the unexpected. JACM has a few tricks up its sleeve
  that you'll have to discover for yourself.

---

## Development Status

JACM is actively in development — the current version is fully playable and enjoyable right
now, with improvements and community suggestions being incorporated over time. If you have
ideas or run into issues, feedback is always welcome!

---

*More machines. More automation. More adventure.*
